name: Sea Anemone Cursor Field
description: Nerine: a dense garden of translucent radial crowns. Brush the water to invite a reach, a recoil, or a current that travels through the colony.
compatibility: Canvas 2D, Pointer Events, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, native dialog and CSS container queries. No runtime dependencies, remote imagery or services.
Mouse, pen, captured touch and keyboard interaction. Reduced motion begins still with a responsive static pose; Resume explicitly enables motion. Background and offscreen work suspends.
Density is bounded at 140 colonies × 48 tendrils. Backing resolution is capped; paths and strokes are batched. Dispose releases animation frames, capture, observers, event handlers and canvas caches.
notes: Each organism has a fixed root, a folded oral disc and three radial rings of curved tentacles. Different phases, lengths and bends give the colonies independent idle motion.

A fixed 120 Hz spring model responds locally to a distance falloff. Recoil also contracts the crown. Pointer movement emits bounded traveling pulses; these are evaluated at each root rather than applied as a uniform screen-wide oscillation.

Interweave mixes separately adjustable attraction, close-range avoidance and ripple forces. The quick modes isolate each behavior. Paused interaction evaluates a static response without advancing time.
Translucent, satin and graphite treatments share the geometry. This is stylized two-dimensional marine artwork with projected curves and depth cues, not a three-dimensional biological simulation.
Six presets, five palettes, local PNG export, fullscreen inspection and shared Lab settings/source export are included.
reuse: AnemoneField in model.js is DOM-free. It exposes semantic input, fixed-step advancement, colony state and preallocated tendril centerlines for an alternate renderer.
createFieldRenderer draws a field independently. createAnemoneField wraps it with input, resize and lifecycle ownership; supply any sized canvas and settings.
The portable source contains the full studio and embed-demo.html with contained, divider and transparent texture examples. No Tampa-specific page logic is required.
